name: element.supersede
title: Supersede element
summary: Supersede an element: set an invalid status of its type and optionally name a successor (relation with meaning succession, written into the successor's file). There is no delete (D-045).
whileReadOnlyReason: Sets an invalid status of the metamodel, and no change can be checked against a missing or faulty metamodel.

status.description: Key or display name of a status of the metamodel, in any case; the key is written. It must be a status of the element's type that the metamodel marks invalid (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#306).

relation.description: Relation kind with meaning succession to write from the successor; needed only when more than one fits the types and the successor does not already have the relation under exactly one of them.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.
